draft.title: Central and peripheral nervous systems
card: the brain and the spinal cord. It receives information, processes it and sends out instructions.
all the nerves outside the brain and spinal cord. It carries messages between the central nervous system and the rest of the body.
Messages travel both ways. Information from the body and the senses goes in to the central nervous system. Instructions go back out to muscles and organs.
The spinal cord belongs to the central nervous system, even though it runs down the back and links to nerves that reach the body.
draft.remember: Central means brain and spinal cord. Peripheral means the nerves that link them to the body.

a.q: Which part of the nervous system does the peripheral nervous system connect to the rest of the body?
opts: The brain and spinal cord
The muscles and glands only
The sense organs only
The brain only
a.why: The peripheral nervous system links the central nervous system, which is the brain and spinal cord, to the rest of the body. The brain alone is wrong because the spinal cord is also part of the central nervous system.
a.clue: Think about what the central nervous system is made of.

b.q: Jess touches a hot pan in her kitchen in Geelong. Her hand nerves send a message towards her spinal cord. Which statement is correct?
opts: The nerves in her hand are part of the peripheral system
The nerves in her hand are part of the central system
The spinal cord is part of the peripheral system
Only the brain is part of the central system
b.why: Nerves in the hand lie outside the brain and spinal cord, so they are peripheral. The spinal cord is tempting to place with the nerves, but it is part of the central nervous system with the brain.
b.clue: Is the hand inside or outside the brain and spinal cord?

b.best: The nerves in her hand are part of the peripheral system

problems.detail: The three wrong options all end in 'only', and the right option is the only one without it. A test-wise student could pick it without knowing the idea. Two distractors (sense organs, muscles and glands) are also not parts of the nervous system, which makes them easy to rule out.

a.q: What is the main job of the peripheral nervous system?
opts: Linking the brain and spinal cord to the rest of the body
Processing information and deciding on instructions
Carrying messages in from the body but not back out
Linking the brain to the spinal cord within the backbone
a.why: The peripheral nervous system is the nerves outside the brain and spinal cord, and it carries messages both ways between them and the body. Processing information and deciding on instructions is the job of the central nervous system, not the peripheral one.
